title: “One of Us” Campaign
excerpt: An opportunity for organizations to invest in the success of a specific Veteran and their K-9 partner, now, and for years to come.

hk9_summary.value: The “One of Us” Campaign gives organizations an opportunity to invest in the success of a specific Veteran and their K-9 partner. Your organization names the K-9, your campaign covers the team’s training, veterinary care, gear, equipment, kenneling and administrative costs, and you become part of the team’s process—from training updates to graduation.
